title: Four Minutes of Forever
hook: Sit face to face. Look toward each other's eyes and stay with your own sensation.
steps: Timer in reach. A raised hand, or the word stop, ends it. Optional line: we look, we notice, we can stop.
Four minutes. Blinks are allowed. Glance away to settle, then return. Do not decode the other face.
When time ends, or a hand or the word stop ends it, look away on purpose. Early still counts.
One notice each, from your own side only. One sentence. Do not interpret your partner's face.
ending: The standard is four minutes inside about fifteen. Ending early completes the session.
pass: Passing finishes the session. Without gaze, attend to your own hands or to sound. You do not have to take hold.
safety: Skip this if anyone has been drinking, or if it is a dare. Stop for dizziness, panic, or a wish to get out. A long look is not consent to touch or sex.

title: Breathe With Me
hook: Sit together and let breathing do what it does. Your own rate is the whole technique.
steps: Seats first. Say: we are not trying to breathe alike. We are sitting here until the breath does whatever it does. The word here is optional.
Start six minutes. Quit performing a slow breath. Do not correct the other person.
Sighs and shifts are allowed. Move if you are in pain. Eyes may stay open.
Wait a moment when it ends. Two sentences each: what you noticed in yourself, then one thing you could point to.
ending: The standard sit is six minutes, inside about fifteen. Claim no sync.
pass: Speak or stop at any time. Stopping is success. A recline is a full version.
safety: Never restrict the breath, and never hold it. Stop for pain, dizziness, or distress. Agree any hand before the timer. This is not a prelude to sex.

title: The Listening Experiment
hook: Uninterrupted speech, then the meaning returned, then a minute to correct it. You swap with equal time.
steps: Name a finishable topic, and say if it is good news. The listener may decline what they cannot hold. The second turn is equal.
Six uninterrupted minutes. You need not fill them. No advice, no matching story, and no question during the turn.
About two minutes: I heard, for the content, and it sounded like you felt, for the feeling. On grief, worry, or anger, no silver lining.
One correction minute. The listener may ask what they missed, and does not argue. Swap. The second speaker still has six minutes.
ending: Talk about the process if you want. Advice waits for a separate yes.
pass: A pause for a break is allowed. Declining the topic, or stopping, completes the session.
safety: A reflection is not agreement, and it is not therapy. If the story is harm, leave the exercise. Being heard is not immunity.

title: The Language of Touch
hook: Mark the menu in private. Play only the overlap you both called welcome tonight.
steps: Unseen, mark hand, shoulder, upper back, linked arms, knees, forearm, hair, face, and one nonsexual form you add: welcome tonight, not tonight, or leave out.
Play only the overlap. An added form needs a yes from both. No overlap: describe a future welcome, and do not demonstrate it.
Before contact, the receiver sets pressure, place, and duration. The giver follows and does not wander or add a place.
Stop, a lifted hand, or moving away retires it. If it finishes, one word: comfort, affection, neutral, or stop. Then swap.
ending: Four is a ceiling. Read the words back. Welcomes expire when you get up.
pass: You may describe instead of touching, and skip the explanation. A pass on the swap is a decline.
safety: This stays nonsexual. Do not ask why, and do not lobby a not tonight. A mark is not consent past this list, and it ends with the evening.

title: The Sixty-Second Embrace
hook: One embrace, errand set down, only while it stays comfortable. Sixty seconds is a proposal, not a dose.
steps: Usual hug first, if you have one, then step apart. Ask: full, side by side, or seated.
Both must say yes for up to sixty seconds. Either may leave sooner. A no means another form, a hand-hold, or a stop.
Before contact: I'm going to step back. No errand talk, no rocking, no harder squeeze as the timer runs, no pinning.
That phrase ends it at once. Early is complete, including at ten seconds. At the alarm, say it and step apart.
One sentence each on how it differed from the routine hug, or from having none.
ending: A second minute only if both of you ask after you have stepped apart.
pass: Stopping before contact completes the session. Skip illness, heat, or a fight still open.
safety: This stays nonsexual. Name desire and leave it. Do not hug toward a truce. Every second can be declined.
